depiction.primary_object: front-facing ship on water with a smaller train beside it
modifiers: smaller front-facing train in lower right corner
wavy water line beneath the ship
depiction.composition: two overlapping front-view vehicles, ship on the left and train in the lower right foreground

readings.meaning: public transit, multimodal transport, or commuter connections
ferry and rail connection or SailRail ticket

ambiguity: At small sizes the overlapping hulls and train cab can crowd together and look like a damaged or jagged ship icon.

modifier_semantics.modifier: smaller front-facing train in lower right corner
modifier_semantics.meaning: combines rail with water transport to indicate public transit, multimodal travel, or ferry-to-train transfers

task_intents: book combined ferry and train ticket

compare sea and rail freight rates

reasoning: Shows a ship on waves paired with a smaller train in the corner, representing multimodal public transit, ferry-rail connections, or intermodal shipping. It fits tasks about transit passes, combined rail-and-sea tickets, and commuter planning, though single-mode trips are better served by a plain train or ship icon.
